content: 1. The combination of darunavir, cobicistat, emtricitabine, and tenofovir alafenamide is a complete regimen indicated for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adults weighing at least 40 kg. It is suitable for individuals with no prior antiretroviral therapy (ART) history or those who are virologically suppressed (HIV-1 RNA <50 copies/mL) on a stable ART regimen for at least six months, provided there are no known substitutions associated with resistance to darunavir or tenofovir. 2. The recommended dosage for adults and children weighing at least 40 kg is one tablet daily, containing darunavir 800 mg, cobicistat 150 mg, emtricitabine 200 mg, and tenofovir alafenamide 10 mg. Safety and efficacy have not been established in individuals weighing less than 40 kg. 3. Darunavir is not recommended for children under three years of age due to toxicity and mortality observed in juvenile rats exposed to darunavir. 4. This regimen is not indicated for pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) to reduce the risk of sexually acquired HIV-1 infection in adults at high risk. 5. Coadministration of this regimen with other antiretroviral therapies is not recommended. 6. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of alfuzosin by inhibiting hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the potential for serious or life-threatening reactions, such as hypotension. 7. Darunavir also increases the levels or effects of alfuzosin via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated for the same reasons. 8. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of alprazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 9. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 10. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of astemizole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 11. Carbamazepine decreases the levels or effects of darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated as it may result in loss of therapeutic effect and development of resistance to darunavir. 12. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of cobimetinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 13. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of cobimetinib via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 14. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of conivaptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Conivaptan also increases cobicistat levels. Coadministration of conivaptan with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is contraindicated. 15. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of conivaptan via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 16. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of dihydroergotamine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the potential for serious or life-threatening reactions, such as acute ergot toxicity characterized by peripheral vasospasm and ischemia. 17. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of dihydroergotamine intranasally via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 18. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of dronedarone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated as dronedarone is a CYP3A4 inhibitor/substrate and a CYP2D6 inhibitor. 19. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of dronedarone via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 20. Darunavir increases the levels of elbasvir/grazoprevir by inhibiting OATP1B1/3 transporters, which may increase the risk of ALT elevations. This combination is contraindicated. 21. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of eletriptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 22. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of eliglustat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated, especially in poor or intermediate metabolizers of CYP2D6. 23. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of eliglustat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 24. Cobicistat increases the levels of duvelisib, a CYP3A4 and BCRP substrate, which may increase the risk of duvelisib toxicities. The duvelisib dose should be reduced to 15 mg BID when coadministered with cobicistat. 25. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir is a complete regimen for HIV and should not be coadministered with other antiretrovirals. Cobicistat increases the levels of this combination, leading to duplicate therapy. This combination is contraindicated. 26. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of eplerenone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 27. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ergoloid mesylates via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 28. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of ergonovine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 29. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ergonovine via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 30. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of ergotamine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the potential for serious or life-threatening reactions, such as acute ergot toxicity. 31. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ergotamine via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 32. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of finerenone via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 33. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of finerenone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 34. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of flibanserin via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of severe hypotension or syncope. 35. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of flibanserin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 36. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of fosaprepitant via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 37. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of gepirone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 38. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of gepirone via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 39. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of indinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated when cobicistat is coadministered with atazanavir due to the risk of indirect hyperbilirubinemia. 40. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of irinotecan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 41. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of irinotecan via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 42. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of irinotecan liposomal by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 43. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of irinotecan liposomal via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 44. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of isavuconazonium sulfate via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 45. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of isavuconazonium sulfate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 46. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of ivabradine via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 47. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of ivabradine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 48. Darunavir increases the levels of lomitapide via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition, leading to several-fold increases in lomitapide levels. This combination is contraindicated. 49. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of lonafarnib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated as lonafarnib is a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate. 50. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of lonafarnib via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 51. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of lovastatin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of serious reactions such as myopathy, including rhabdomyolysis. 52. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of lovastatin via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 53. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of lurasidone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 54. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of lurasidone via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 55. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of mavacamten via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of heart failure caused by systolic dysfunction. 56. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of mavacamten by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 57. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of methylergonovine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the potential for serious or life-threatening reactions, such as acute ergot toxicity. 58. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of methylergonovine via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 59. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of midazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of prolonged sedation or respiratory depression. 60. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of naloxegol via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated as it may precipitate opioid withdrawal symptoms. 61. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of naloxegol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 62. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of pacritinib via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 63. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of pacritinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 64. Phenobarbital decreases the levels or effects of darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated as it may result in loss of therapeutic effect and development of resistance to darunavir. 65. Cobicistat increases the levels or effects of pimozide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of QT prolongation. 66. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of pimozide via CYP3A4 metabolism inhibition. This combination is contraindicated. 67. Phenytoin decreases the levels or effects of darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated as it may result in loss of therapeutic effect and development of resistance to darunavir.
